verdict.rationale: Automations are a fair question for an AI infrastructure platform, but the evidence describes no product-level scheduling, triggers, or recurring workflows. Async inference and training jobs are one-off background executions, not configurable automations. MCP servers and coding-agent integrations let an external agent manage the workspace, which is a developer building block rather than this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
